definitions.gloss: vaguely; dimly; obscurely; in a hazy way
definitions.explanation: Describes a state where something is unclear, undefined, or lacking concrete form. Used for thoughts, feelings, memories, and impressions that are not sharply defined.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{漠然|ばくぜん}と⟦{考|かんが}えている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: I'm vaguely thinking about the future.

examples.japanese: {漠然|ばくぜん}と⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じていた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I was feeling a vague sense of anxiety.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、{漠然|ばくぜん}と⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暮|く}らしたい→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っていた→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{具体的|ぐたいてき}→具体的：04781_gutaiteki⟧な⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I vaguely wanted to live abroad, but I had no concrete plans.

notes:
USAGE:
Also used as a たる-adjective (⟦{漠然|ばくぜん}→漠然：09120_bakuzen⟧たる) in literary contexts, and as a とした-adjective ({漠然|ばくぜん}と⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧) which is more common in everyday use. The adverbial form {漠然|ばくぜん}と modifies verbs of thinking, feeling, and perceiving.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {漠然|ばくぜん}と⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧ (a vague anxiety)
- {漠然|ばくぜん}と⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦イメージ→イメージ：03832_imeeji⟧ (a vague image)
- {漠然|ばくぜん}と⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel vaguely)
- {漠然|ばくぜん}と⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧ (to think vaguely)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ぼんやり→ぼんやり：03727_bonyari⟧: vaguely, absentmindedly — more colloquial; can also mean absent-minded or dazed
- なんとなく: somehow, for some reason — more casual and conversational
